Command: Do not break a bone of the second Passover lamb
Summary: No bone of the second Passover lamb may be broken, as with the first Passover; all its ordinances are kept.
Commandment: Do not break any bone of the second Passover lamb.
Application: The moral/ceremonial/civil division is a traditional classification, not Scripture's own division; this law is traditionally classed as ceremonial. The unbroken-bone detail carries over whole to the second date, as do all the ordinances. John 19:36 applies the detail to Jesus.
Purpose: Scripture's stated context: the men defiled by a dead body asked why they should be kept back from offering the LORD's offering — and God answered with a second date, not a refusal (Numbers 9:6-11).
